A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Company Description

LAB Tech Analytics is a dynamic and forward-thinking small company dedicated to revolutionizing data-driven solutions. We empower businesses to unlock the true potential of their data assets with our comprehensive suite of services. From our top-notch data recruitment and training hub to our cutting-edge data products and services, we provide end-to-end solutions for every stage of the data lifecycle. Our expert team combines technical excellence with deep industry knowledge to deliver actionable insights, advanced analytics, robust data infrastructure, and strategic guidance.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Software Engineer Intern. The Software Engineer Intern will be responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining software applications, assisting in the design and implementation of new features, and collaborating with the engineering team to improve existing systems. The intern will also participate in code reviews, write clear and efficient code, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.


Qualifications

  • Experience in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C++)
  • Understanding of software development methodologies and tools
  • Interest in learning and both front-end and back-end development
  • Familiarity with databases and data structures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience with data analytics and machine learning is a plus

title: Audio Transcription Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.



If Interested, kindly send your resume at:

title: Advogado associado
description:
Vaga: Advogado(a) Pleno – Direito Bancário / CEF

Modalidade: Home Office

Escritório: Coelho e Gavioli – Advogados Associados

Sobre a vaga

O escritório Coelho e Gavioli – Advogados Associados está em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno com experiência em Direito Bancário , especialmente em demandas envolvendo a Caixa Econômica Federal (CEF) .

O(a) profissional atuará no contencioso cível bancário, com foco em estratégia, análise processual e condução de ações de média complexidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerir e conduzir processos judiciais da CEF , assegurando qualidade técnica e eficiência nos resultados;
  • Elaborar petições, relatórios e peças processuais em diferentes fases processuais;
  • Realizar análises de risco e propostas de acordo , com visão estratégica e foco em resultados;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e treinamentos jurídicos internos ;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e a manutenção dos padrões de qualidade do escritório.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Direito e inscrição ativa na OAB ;
  • Experiência comprovada em Direito Bancário , preferencialmente com casos envolvendo a Caixa Econômica Federal ;
  • Capacidade analítica, senso de responsabilidade e boa comunicação escrita;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com facilidade para trabalho remoto e em equipe.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em contencioso de massa bancário ;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas jurídicos como CPJ , PJe e plataformas de bancos públicos.

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Sr
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de DESENVOLVEDOR .NET SENIOR


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de TI;

Experiência com codificação de aplicações C#.NET, ASP.NET;

• MCSA: Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate: Web Applications;

• MCSD: Microsoft Certified Solutions Developer: App Builder;

• Microsoft Certified Azure Developer Associate.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.

Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.

Experiência na área de Sistema Operacional Windows Server:

• configuração do Internet Information Server;

• configuração, instalação e publicação de aplicações e assemblies .NET;

• conceitos de versionamento de assemblies e binding policies em WCF (Windows Communication Foundation);

• conhecimentos de COM e COM+;

• conhecimentos de MTS;

• conceitos de Windows Internals;

• conceitos de Active Directory;

• conceitos de Windows API

Experiência na área de Desenvolvimento Linguagem C# .Net:

• conceitos de interoperabilidade entre plataforma .NET (código gerenciado / managed) e COM+ (código não gerenciado / unmanaged);

• conceitos e técnicas de segurança em .NET (Autenticação, autorização e comunicação segura);

• criação de WebServices em WCF para IIS/WAS;

• conceitos de XML e XML Schema;

• configuração e uso do framework de persistência NHibernate;

• conceitos e aplicações de padrões de projeto (designpatterns);

• conceitos e técnicas de segurança em aplicações COM+;

• desenvolvimento de aplicações WIN32 e WIN64;

• desenvolvimento de aplicações WEB;

• desenvolvimento de aplicações de arquitetura multicamadas;

• conhecimentos de desenvolvimento de aplicações de arquitetura cliente / servidor.

Experiência na área de Banco de Dados:

• conhecimento de bancos de dados e configuração (ODBC);

• conhecimentos em bancos de dados Microsoft SQL Server e IBM DB2;

• conceitos de ADO.

Conhecimento na área de Cloud (Azure):

• em design de arquitetura para Cloud (Azure);

• em desenvolvimento de soluções .NET para Azure.


Desejável

Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.


Informações adicionais:

Atuação Remota

Vale Alimentação/Refeição | Wiipo Flex

description:
Buscamos parceiros comerciais para levar para sua rede de clientes a oferta dos produtos e serviços da Nord Investimentos .


Somos hoje a maior casa de research independente do país e também temos uma das principais Consultorias de Investimentos , sendo reconhecida como Top Consultoria na XP, BTG e Avenue.


Com mais de R$8 bilhões sob gestão, temos uma metodologia e sistema próprios que entrega um altíssimo nível em Wealth Management . Somos um integrador oficial Mendix no Brasil, e buscamos alguém para criar soluções digitais inovadoras para clientes de diversos setores.

  • Domínio de Mendix Studio Pro (UX, microflows/nanoflows, integrações, Java Actions).

  • Base sólida em desenvolvimento de software (Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL).

  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

  • Desejável experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis

  • Projetos desafiadores e inovadores.
  • Certificações e treinamentos oficiais Mendix.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e oportunidade real de crescimento.

title: Audio Transcribers
description:
We’re Hiring: Freelance Transcribers


We are looking for experienced and detail-oriented freelance transcribers to join our team for an exciting transcription project. The task involves converting non-English audio files (primarily podcast episodes) into accurate written text in accordance with the provided project guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen to and transcribe audio files with high accuracy and attention to detail
  • Follow specific formatting and linguistic guidelines
  • Ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks


Requirements:

✅ Prior experience in transcription (especially non-English content)

✅ Excellent listening and language skills in the target language

✅ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

✅ Ability to meet deadlines

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: UX - Produtos Digitais da Indústria


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Inovação e desenvolvimento são parte do DNA do Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte de evolução. Estamos em busca de um talento colaborativo e analítico para atuar na criação de um sistema inédito de governança e acompanhamento dos programas de Desenvolvimento e Capacitação Industrial.

O projeto visa centralizar informações, automatizar processos e otimizar a alocação de mão de obra, trazendo mais eficiência, agilidade e inteligência à gestão fabril.

Se você quer contribuir com soluções que conectam tecnologia, pessoas e resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Formação Acadêmica: Design ou áreas correlatas


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces e fluxos de usuário intuitivos e eficazes, seguindo as melhores práticas de UX e os padrões de design do Grupo Boticário;
  • Colaborar com designers de produto e engenheiros na adoção, uso e documentação dos componentes;
  • Prototipar e conduzir testes de usabilidade para validar as soluções de design e aprimorar a experiência do usuário;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo a implementação adequada e a consistência visual das interfaces;
  • Produzir e manter a documentação de design, incluindo guias de estilo e especificações técnicas;
  • Apresentar soluções de design e coletar feedback de stakeholders para promover melhorias contínuas



Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Formação em Design ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em UX para aplicações web ou mobile;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design como Figma ou similares;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de produto;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes multifuncionais, multilíngues e colaborativos, com autonomia;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e trabalho em squads multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento sólido em princípios de design de interação, usabilidade e acessibilidade.
  • Conhecimento sobre Product Designer, aplicando conceitos de Arquitetura de Informação, Visual, UX Writing, Pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa, além de métodos de facilitação;


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento básico de React.


Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa para resolver problemas e buscar soluções inovadoras.
  • Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar para integrar aspectos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e engajar diversos perfis profissionais.
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco em qualidade e prazos.



Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Graduado) R$1.500,00

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Local: São José dos Pinhais – PR

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento básico de React.


Soft Skills:

  • Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar para integrar aspectos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e engajar diversos perfis profissionais.
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco em qualidade e prazos.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Consultor (a) MM - Senior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value

As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.

Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.

Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!




Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Atuação como Consultor (a) MM Funcional nos produtos NTT DATA;


Requisitos:


  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência com SAP MM;
  • Pelo menos 1 projeto completo de implementação ou rollout em SAP S/4HANA;
  • Experiência prática de no mínimo 2 anos com Localização Brasil;
  • Atuação comprovada em projetos com cenários de comércio exterior (exportação/importação);
  • Conhecimento de integração MM com FI, CO, SD e GRC;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, configuração, testes e suporte pós go-live;
  • Capacidade de redigir especificações funcionais e técnicas claras para ABAP;
  • Capacidade de conduzir workshops e documentar soluções.




Contratação: Regime CLT



Junte-se ao nosso time inspirador, confiável e solidário. Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho, valorizamos a integridade e a responsabilidade pessoal em todos os níveis desde o primeiro dia, tratamos todos com dignidade e respeito, e estendemos nossa responsabilidade à nossa comunidade, à sociedade e ao meio ambiente.



*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Devops Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa DevOps Pleno para se juntar ao nosso time e nos ajudar a construir, escalar e manter ambientes modernos e resilientes na AWS. Se você é apaixonado por automação, infraestrutura como código e cultura DevOps, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenho, automação e manutenção de ambientes em AWS;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de CI/CD eficientes e seguras;
  • Trabalhar com clusters Kubernetes (EKS) em produção;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar infraestruturas com Terraform e Helm;
  • Monitorar ambientes e serviços com ferramentas modernas de observabilidade;
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e arquitetura para garantir escalabilidade, performance e segurança;
  • Participar de revisões técnicas, troubleshooting de incidentes e implementação de boas práticas DevOps.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência prática com AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, EKS, etc.);
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (provisionamento, deployment, troubleshooting);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI ou similares);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos;
  • Experiência com Terraform e Helm Charts;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em GCP será um diferencial.

title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
description:
Venha fazer parte do nosso time


Procuramos um(a) profissional que domine as dinâmicas das redes sociais e conteúdo, que tenha visão de futuro sobre o uso da IA na automação, análise e personalização de conteúdo em escala . O coordenador(a) será responsável por liderar a estratégia e operação dos canais sociais, explorando ao máximo as possibilidades da IA para ampliar o alcance, o engajamento e a conversão de usuários no universo das apostas esportivas online.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e executar o plano estratégico de conteúdo para redes sociais (Instagram, Twitter/X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, etc.), com foco em engajamento e aquisição.
  • Coordenar a criação de conteúdo textual e visual (posts, vídeos curtos, memes, lives, etc.) alinhado com o universo das apostas esportivas, entretenimento e tendências culturais brasileiras.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA generativa (como ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, etc.) para automação, ideação, criação e testes de conteúdo em escala.
  • Liderar equipe de redatores, designers e criadores externos ou internos.
  • Monitorar KPIs (engajamento, crescimento, conversão, ROI de campanhas) e ajustar estratégias com base em dados.
  • Gerenciar o calendário editorial e acompanhar eventos esportivos e culturais para ativação em tempo real.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de CRM, produto e afiliados para alinhar as ações de mídia e conteúdo com metas comerciais.
  • Garantir que toda comunicação esteja alinhada às diretrizes legais e de compliance do mercado de apostas no Brasil.




Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de mídias sociais e produção de conteúdo no mercado brasileiro.
  • Conhecimento do setor de apostas esportivas, cassinos online ou fintechs voltadas ao entretenimento.
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao marketing e conteúdo.
  • Domínio das principais redes sociais e suas dinâmicas de engajamento.
  • Excelência em português (redação criativa, fluente e adaptada ao tom digital).
  • Perfil analítico e data-driven.

Desejáveis:

  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Experiência com campanhas de tráfego pago (Meta Ads, Google Ads).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Notion, Figma, Trello, Hootsuite, etc.
  • Experiência anterior com conteúdo esportivo, e-sports ou creators digitais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com cobertura ao vivo de eventos esportivos e uso de IA em tempo real (ex: geração de conteúdo automático com base em estatísticas do jogo);
  • Habilidade com automação de workflows sociais e uso de APIs de IA;
  • Noções de regulamentação de publicidade e apostas no Brasil;
  • Conhecimento em criação de conteúdo audiovisual com IA (ex: dublagem automática, avatares, vídeos curtos automatizados).

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Title: SAP ABAP Consultant

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Contract


Job Description:

• Need an ABAP consultant to do the Brazil tax reform

• Need support for SAP Note implementation

• Support for Prerequisites dependency on SAP notes, work with SAP, should be able to work and analyze current FRICEW objects

• Well, worse with impact analysis

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and enhance ABAP programs to support Brazil's tax reform requirements

• Work closely with functional teams, FI, MM, and SD to implement localization changes

• Modify reports, interfaces, and forms, eg, NFe SPED, as per new tax rules

• Perform unit testing and support integration testing

Requirements

• Strong ABAP development skills, including Reports, BAPIs, BADIs, and Enhancements

• Experience with Brazil localization, not the Fiscal tax procedures, SPED

• Knowledge of S4HANA and tax compliance tools is a plus

• Analyze Brazil's fiscal mandates and SAP ECC capabilities

• Configure SAP ECC to support CBS IBS and Excise Tax

• Implement Nota Fiscal and SPED Fiscal workflows

• Integrate SAP Document and Reporting Compliance tools

• Support for EFD file generation and digital signature

• Update MM and SD pricing rules

• Compatibility with fiscal printers and POS systems if applicable

• Real-time tax calculation and reporting dashboards

• Smart form changes

• Data migration as necessary based on a change in configuration

• Provide testing, training, and go-live support

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Shopify Web Designer
description:
Company Description

Step Labs is a web development and design agency dedicated to partnering with 7-8 figure e-commerce brands to drive revenue growth. We focus on helping ambitious founders scale their businesses efficiently through research-focused split tests. Our custom revenue growth systems guarantee a 30% revenue uplift within 3 months through weekly split-tests. We are passionate about helping our clients achieve measurable success and sustainable growth.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Shopify focussed Web Designer. The Shopify Web Designer will be responsible for designing and implementing high-quality, responsive web designs. Day-to-day tasks include graphic design, front-end development, and creating graphics that enhance the user experience. The web designer will collaborate closely with our team to ensure that all designs align with our clients' brand identity and contribute to their revenue growth.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Web Design and Responsive Web Design
  • Fluency in English - do not apply if you are not fluent in english﻿
  • Strong skills with autolayout in Figma, and with creating high-quality graphics in Adobe CC
  • Experience working with Shopify and an understanding of e-commerce design principles
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote setting
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing project requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, or a related field is preferred
  • Experience in conducting user research and implementing data-driven design changes is a plus

title: Marketing Content Specialist
description:
Marketing Content Specialist


How to Stand Out


When applying, send an email to and please include:

  • In the subject line write the subject line from the top of this job description.
  • Your answer to this question: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "The best way to know any future is to cause one"
  • Three content samples (ads, reels, or emails)


Department: Marketing

Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Pay Range: $1,500 – $2,200 USD / month + performance bonus


About the Role


Your mission: capture real customer wins and turn them into daily content across ads, social, and email. This role owns the proof-fed Ad Factory that delivers “more, better, new” creatives every week.

Raw > polished. Volume > perfection. Consistency compounds.


What You'll Do


  • Harvest Proof: collect screenshots, testimonials, videos, reviews, and milestones weekly.
  • Build Ads: use AI tools (ChatGPT, Descript, Claude, OpusClip, Canva AI) to write hooks, edit clips, and assemble 10–50 ad variants/week.
  • Publish Daily: post proof-driven content on FB, IG, YT, TikTok, LinkedIn + send 2 emails/week.
  • Track Performance: monitor creative winners and cost per engaged lead.


Success Metrics


  • 10–50 new ad variants / week
  • Daily organic posts across platforms
  • 2 emails / week built from real proof
  • 70 % + of content sourced from actual customer wins

You Are


  • A fast executor who loves shipping daily
  • Skilled at short-form editing (CapCut / Descript / OpusClip)
  • Comfortable writing short copy (hooks / CTAs / captions)
  • AI-native — you already use ChatGPT or Claude in your workflow
  • Organized, fluent in English, and hungry to learn


Compensation


  • Full-Time $1,500 – $2,200 USD / month
  • $100–$300 bonus for hitting output + ROI goals


Stack


ChatGPT • Claude • Descript • OpusClip • Canva • Lumen5 • CapCut • Publer • HubSpot / HighLevel • Notion • Zapier / Make

title: DevOps Pleno
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Cloud Operations Lead
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Operations Lead com sólida experiência em AWS e vivência prática em operações e sustentação de ambientes críticos . Este(a) profissional será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de sustentação Cloud, garantindo estabilidade, performance e governança dos ambientes em nuvem.

Além de atuar como referência técnica, será o elo entre as áreas de operação, engenharia e gestão, apoiando na resolução de incidentes complexos, na implementação de melhorias contínuas e na disseminação das melhores práticas de ITIL e Cloud Operations .


Papéis e Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de sustentação Cloud, atuando como referência em AWS;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes de alta complexidade, garantindo a restauração rápida dos serviços;
  • Apoiar o Service Manager e o time de Suporte N2/N3 em ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Implementar melhorias de automação, observabilidade e performance em ambientes AWS;
  • Garantir a aplicação das práticas ITIL (Gestão de Incidentes, Mudanças e Problemas);
  • Apoiar na criação de playbooks, runbooks e padrões operacionais para o time;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e operacionais com clientes e áreas internas;
  • Atuar na governança de custos e eficiência operacional dos ambientes;
  • Promover a cultura de melhoria contínua e excelência técnica dentro da equipe.


Qualificações Essenciais:

  • Conhecimento em ITIL (Gestão de Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças e SLAs);
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda, VPC, etc.);
  • Vivência prática em ambientes de sustentação e operações Cloud;
  • Experiência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation, ou similares);
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em Linux/Windows Server, redes e segurança em Cloud;
  • Experiência em pipeline CI/CD e ferramentas como GitHub Actions ou AWS CodePipeline.
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:

  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator ou DevOps Engineer);
  • Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em times de Sustentação/AMS;
  • Experiência com FinOps e otimização de custos em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento adicional em Azure ou GCP será considerado um diferencial.

title: SAP Cutover Lead
description:
Senior SAP Cutover Lead

Location: Remote – Brazil

Experience: 10+ Years


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP Cutover Lead to plan, manage, and execute cutover activities across complex SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA, RISE, and cloud-based migrations . The ideal candidate will be responsible for orchestrating all phases of the technical and business cutover, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring a smooth transition from legacy to target systems with minimal disruption to operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the end-to-end cutover strategy , timeline, and execution plan for SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Coordinate with functional, technical, BASIS, infrastructure, and business process teams to define cutover tasks, dependencies, and sequencing.
  • Drive the development of cutover checklists, runbooks, and readiness assessments .
  • Conduct mock cutovers and rehearsals to validate timing, resources, and risk mitigation.
  • Monitor and report progress during each phase of the cutover cycle; manage go/no-go checkpoints.
  • Identify and proactively resolve cutover issues and risks to maintain go-live stability.
  • Collaborate with project management, business owners, and system integrators to ensure alignment with overall deployment milestones.
  • Facilitate post-cutover reviews, stabilization planning, and transition to support teams.
  • Maintain detailed documentation and ensure compliance with change control and audit standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of SAP experience, with 5+ years leading cutover planning and execution for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or RISE programs.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale, multi-stream cutovers involving multiple systems and geographies.
  • Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, BASIS operations, and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills—capable of working with distributed global teams.
  • Hands-on experience with cutover management tools (e.g., SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, MS Project, Jira, or Smartsheet).
  • Ability to anticipate risks and design effective fallback and recovery plans.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP RISE migrations, Greenfield/Brownfield implementations , and system consolidations .
  • Familiarity with cloud hosting (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and hybrid landscape cutovers.
  • Certification in SAP Activate or PMP/Prince2 project management.


Why Join Us

  • Lead mission-critical cutovers across global SAP programs.
  • Collaborate with seasoned SAP professionals across functional and technical domains.
  • Remote flexibility with opportunities for long-term global project exposure.

  • Identify and proactively resolve cutover issues and risks to maintain go-live stability.
  • Collaborate with project management, business owners, and system integrators to ensure alignment with overall deployment milestones.

  • Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills—capable of working with distributed global teams.

  • Ability to anticipate risks and design effective fallback and recovery plans.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP RISE migrations, Greenfield/Brownfield implementations , and system consolidations .
  • Familiarity with cloud hosting (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and hybrid landscape cutovers.
  • Certification in SAP Activate or PMP/Prince2 project management.


Why Join Us

  • Lead mission-critical cutovers across global SAP programs.
  • Collaborate with seasoned SAP professionals across functional and technical domains.
  • Remote flexibility with opportunities for long-term global project exposure.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Customer Support Specialist – Fintech SaaS (Remote)

About Hitch

Hitch is a rapidly growing fintech platform that powers digital home equity and non-QM lending experiences for banks, credit unions, and mortgage lenders. Our technology enables lenders to originate and manage HELOC, DSCR, and bridge loans through a modern white-label point of sale, broker portal, and automated underwriting system.


We work with top lenders such as Deephaven Mortgage and MyEQNow to modernize how home financing is done.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer Support Specialist who will serve as the first line of communication with our B2B clients — including mortgage lenders, brokers, and operations teams. This role combines client-facing communication, technical troubleshooting, and root cause analysis to ensure smooth platform performance and client satisfaction.

You’ll work closely with our product, QA, and engineering teams to identify, reproduce, and resolve issues reported by clients.


Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client support tickets and platform questions.
  • Investigate client-reported issues to identify the root cause and gather technical details for engineering (browser logs, screenshots, timestamps, file IDs, etc.).
  • Communicate findings and next steps clearly and professionally in English.
  • Maintain organized ticket documentation using tools like Zendesk, Linear, or Asana.
  • Partner with QA and developers to test bug fixes and verify resolutions.
  • Create and update internal and client-facing help articles or training guides.
  • Track recurring issues and propose process or product improvements.
  • Participate in weekly operations and client status calls as needed.


Requirements
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills (C1 or native-level).
  • Prior experience in customer support, client success, or QA — ideally within a SaaS, fintech, or mortgage/real estate environment.
  • Strong ability to analyze issues logically, gather evidence, and identify patterns.
  • Comfortable using ticketing tools (Zendesk, Asana, Linear, or Jira) and communication tools (Slack, Teams, Zoom).
  • Basic understanding of web systems (APIs, integrations, user permissions, file uploads, etc.) or willingness to learn.
  • Detail-oriented, patient, and proactive — able to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work remotely and collaborate across time zones (U.S. & Latin America).


Preferred (Nice-to-Have)
  • Experience supporting mortgage technology platforms (Encompass, Blend, ICE, LOS/POS systems).
  • Familiarity with RegTech, underwriting workflows, or document processing systems.
  • Technical aptitude — comfort with inspecting browser dev tools or reading simple logs.
  • Fluency in Portuguese or Spanish (to collaborate with our Brazil-based engineering team).


Why Join Hitch
  • Work directly with the founders and a global, mission-driven team.
  • Learn the inner workings of fintech SaaS and digital mortgage platforms.
  • Make a direct impact on client satisfaction and product reliability.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location.

title: Calling and Lead Generation Specialist for Commercial Real Estate
description:
Location:  Remote

Contract:  Independent Contractor

Job Type:  Full-Time, Monday-Friday, EST

Salary:  Competitive base


Summary:

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Calling and Lead Generation Specialist for Commercial Real Estate to join our growing team. The role requires someone who is both skilled at online research and comfortable making a high volume of phone calls every day. You will be responsible for sourcing information on and engaging potential capital providers for our commercial real estate debt and equity brokerage firm, with a focus on the U.S. market. This includes conducting targeted research across multiple channels to uncover lender and investor criteria and then reaching out by phone to qualify their interest in active opportunities. The ideal candidate is organized, persistent, and adept at gathering and analyzing information online while confidently engaging prospects over the phone. This position offers the chance to develop expertise in real estate capital markets while making a direct impact on the growth of our firm.


Responsibilities:

  • Outreach and Engagement:  Implement deal specific outreach strategies (cold calling and email campaigns) to gauge interest in active opportunities, and nurture them toward further discussions.
  • Appointment Setting:  Schedule and coordinate meetings between qualified capital providers and our senior team, ensuring a smooth handoff for follow-up discussions.
  • Phone-Based Research: Conduct introductory calls with lenders and investors to capture high-level criteria, including preferred loan types, deal sizes, and geographic focus.
  • Web-Based Research: Review lender websites, industry databases, and online resources to identify, update, and validate current lending programs and parameters.
  • Database Research: Review and update existing capital provider investment parameters in our CRM, ensuring all information is accurate and up to date.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with senior team members to align outreach efforts with active deals and capital-raising initiatives.
  • Reporting: Prepare and share weekly progress updates on outreach activities, database updates, and key findings from conversations.
  • Market Intelligence:  Stay current on industry trends, lender activity, market conditions, and competitor movements within the U.S. commercial real estate sector; provide valuable insights to the team.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years in research, business development, sales support, or a related role.
  • Preferred: Experience in real estate, finance, or capital brokerage, particularly within the U.S. commercial real estate market.
  • Fluent in English (C1 or higher), with strong verbal communication skills and confidence in making professional outreach calls.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of outreach calls each week.
  • Skilled in gathering, synthesizing, and presenting information from databases, websites, and direct conversations.
  • Skilled at leveraging online research tools (including websites, LinkedIn, and industry databases) to source and evaluate capital providers.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple outreach activities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and CRM systems (HubSpot preferred).
  • Tech-savvy with experience using cold-emailing and calling tools (e.g., Instantly) and best practices.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

Our Company:

We are a dynamic, growing entrepreneurial company established in 2020, specializing in capital brokerage services to help real estate owners and developers raise debt and equity capital. Our focus is primarily on multifamily and hospitality properties, although we have successfully financed a wide range of property types. We thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment and seek passionate, driven individuals who want to be a part of our exciting journey.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation structure.
  • Opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial and collaborative team environment.
  • Fully remote work.
  • Growth and professional development opportunities within a fast-growing company.


If you're a results-driven individual with a passion for real estate, we encourage you to apply and join our team!

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

title: Talent Development Partner
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Golang Developer
description:
Job Title: Golang Developer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Start date: Immediate

For the Golang demand, the account requires candidates with 8 years of overall experience to work remotely in Brazil as contractors.

The client has been rejected based on their resume, so we need to send resumes that showcase most of their experience with Golang, Node, and React.

Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to develop and enhance

high-performance and highly scalable backend services. While the role still values familiarity with Node.js

and React, the primary emphasis is on Go, gRPC, Kafka, Kubernetes, and cloud native development

across AWS & GCP. You’ll own the creation of robust backend services that interact with MongoDB,

stream data through Kafka, and run reliably in containerized environments.


Responsibilities Include:

This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities, including:

● Design, implement, and maintain data-intensive Go and node gRPC APIs.

● Build, containerize, and deploy scalable Go microservices on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE).

● Refactor and modernize legacy Node.js services into idiomatic Go services, improving

performance and stability.

● Integrate and operate Apache Kafka pipelines for high throughput event streaming, including

producer/consumer logic, schema management, and monitoring.

● Leverage cloud services on both AWS and GCP to build resilient, cost-effective solutions.

● Troubleshoot technical issues.

● Conduct thorough code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and champion best practices around

testing, CI/CD, and security.

● Participate in architectural design reviews, providing pragmatic feedback on scalability, fault

tolerance, and cost optimization.

● Collaborate closely with Product, Program Management, QA, and other teams to align delivery

with business goals.

● Provide realistic level of effort (LOE) estimates during quarterly PI planning, accounting for

dependencies and risk factors.

● Prototype emerging technologies to accelerate engineering velocity and reduce operational

overhead.


Qualities / Experience we are seeking

This role focuses on software development for backend systems to create GRCP and REST APIs that

will consume/update data to MongoDB, and applications that read, process data, and write to Kafka

streams. The right individual will have the following skills and experience to be successful in this role:

● 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering

● 3+ years of experience building production-grade grade highly scalable Go services

● Experience writing high-performance gRPC and REST clients and servers, including protobuf

contracts and Client/Server communication

● Experience developing Kafka stream processing applications, schemas, managing topics, ACLs,

consumers, and offset handling

● 3+ years of experience with AWS (S3, Cloudfront, EKS, etc.)

● 1+ year of experience with GCP (Cloud Storage, Kafka, GKE, CDN, etc.)

● 2+ years of experience using and designing MongoDB


Nice to have

● 2+ years of experience developing application services using Node + Mongo + Express +

front-end frameworks/libraries like React

● 3+ years of experience with EKS/GKE, Helm charts, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines

● 1+ years of Linux bash scripting for automation and ops tasks

● Exposure to Redis, Docker, Git, observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

● Excellent problem-solving, clear communication, and ability to work effectively in a globally environment

distributed team

● Experience with mongo schemas, indexing strategies, and sharding considerations

● Experience with ETL pipelines

● Experience with CRUD operations

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.


O seu papel como Software Engineering Backend:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.

title: Power System Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for PSA Engineer – Network Transmission who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

  • 5+ years of work experience in customizing and delivering Energy Management Systems preferably e-terrra AEMS - Reliance
  • Should have worked on Power Systems applications for transmission (Load flow, contingency analysis, Power Factor etc)
  • 5 + years of experience with C++, Java or other related language.
  • 5 years of experience with LINUX and Windows Operating Systems

Roles & Responsibilities

Responsible for advanced Power Systems Application for Transmission software development and successful delivery of assigned functions to meet corporate project/product commitments. The responsibilities include: working with Electric Utilities or ISOs (Independent System Operators) and Transmission System Operators (TSOs) on functional software specifications, designing, coding, testing, integration, application tuning and delivery

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers
